content.name: Tahlia Brennan
content.title: Product Manager
content.summary: Product manager with nine years in SaaS, travel bookings and health technology, who moved into product from customer success. Own the clinic booking product at a Brisbane health-tech company used by 1,100 allied health practices, where online booking share grew from 38% to 61%. Grounded in customer research and steady delivery with small cross-functional teams.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Own the online booking and reminders product for 1,100 physiotherapy, podiatry and psychology practices across Australia.
Grew the share of appointments booked online from 38% to 61% by shipping deposit payments, waitlists and a simpler mobile flow.
Partnered with the privacy officer on consent and data retention requirements under the Privacy Act.
Run fortnightly discovery calls with practice managers and share insights with sales and support.

experience.title: Associate Product Manager
bullets: Managed the operator dashboard for 900 tour and activity operators.
Rebuilt cancellation and refund settings during 2020 travel restrictions, reducing refund-related tickets by 40%.
Defined product metrics and a weekly reporting pack for the leadership team.

experience.title: Customer Success Lead
bullets: Led a team of four managing 250 accounts for a job management app used by trades businesses.
Turned recurring feature requests into a monthly product feedback report, which led to three roadmap items.
Lowered annual churn on managed accounts from 14% to 10%.

achievements.title: Customer impact award
achievements.detail: Wynnum Health Tech annual customer impact award (2023) for the deposits and waitlist release.

achievements.title: Meetup speaker
achievements.detail: Spoke on moving from customer success into product at a Brisbane product community meetup.
